Correct or remove a Franklin Navigator profile

Basic factual corrections are free. You can also request removal of a profile from public view at no cost. Neither requires Community Membership or payment.

Choose the request you need. For a removal request, Franklin Navigator may confirm that you own, manage, or are authorized to act for the profile before public suppression is approved.

Do not include passwords, payment data, medical information, government ID numbers, or other sensitive personal information.

No payment or membership is required.
How public removal works

An approved removal suppresses the profile from Franklin Navigator public display. Lawful internal provenance and suppression history may be retained so normal data refreshes do not accidentally republish the profile. Reinstatement requires an explicit reviewed action.
